phase_name: Add reachability detection and a --dispatch-block output mode to the probe

objectives.description: Re-read lean-mcp-preflight-check.sh in full before editing
Add probe_reachability() function with ps snapshot, self-match guard, /proc/<pid>/environ cross-check
Add --dispatch-block flag parsing composing with 5 ignored positionals
Emit <lean-readiness-context> block in --dispatch-block mode with project root, registration, tier, interpretation rule, necessary-not-sufficient note, degraded-mode-proceed statement
Order reachability probe after registration confirmed present
Update header documentation (flag, reachability semantics, /proc caveat, self-match guard, cost line)

approaches_tried.reason: coreutils multicall binary dispatches on argv[0]/basename; renamed copy errors 'unknown program' at exec time rather than at cp time, so the background process exits immediately and never appears in ps. Switched to a small bash script with a sleep body instead.
